exactRequest.prompt:
Create a polished full-screen 1536×1024 DESKTOP PRODUCT DESIGN for 在场, an intimate ongoing conversation with a thoughtful companion in the attached literary room. The ONLY image input is the clean EMPTY room; no old UI, person, mature face or screenshot input. Preserve its complete coherent rainy-night room, close camera, exact window architecture, left writing desk and wooden chair, central glowing porcelain lamp and side table, right cream window bench, plaid pillows, knitted throw, floor and rug. Whole scene is one believable cool rainy-window / warm amber indoor light field, not a black filter over daytime. No new human figure or new avatar art: this is a focused conversation whose partner has yielded visual space to the work, not a character-matrix production.

Both directions must use this SAME product ruler: small "在场" wordmark at x40,y34; calm three-item navigation "聊天  今天  留下" centered around x768,y36, active 聊天 indicated discreetly; quiet window controls at top right. A single persistent composer at x80,y884,width944,height72, rounded 22px, warm smoked-brown translucent material, warm-ivory input text, one small plus at the left and one warm send arrow at the right. The composer never moves to a new screen corner, no second input, no explanatory strip under it. Top navigation and composer keep exactly these anchors through all later states. Real Chinese body text at about22px with34–36px line spacing, quiet16px source links, well-formed readable mathematics. Do not shrink text to fit. Restrained Apple-like hierarchy and precise spacing, typography and interfaces crafted for the room rather than pasted over it.

The representative conversation is public invented sample mathematics, not personal document data. Show the user asking in a natural short group near x96,y132:
"这两处都说‘自由度’，是在说同一件事吗？"
Two attached PDF objects are TINY upright muted-red book-cover rectangles, each roughly42×56px with a fine gold curved mark, short legible labels "线代" and "微分" only. They are graspable small objects, never wide gray attachment bars or long filenames. AI is identified unobtrusively as "祥子" at the start of her response, not a robot/tool status label. Warmth comes from precise attention and useful joint work, no generic reassurance.

Use these actual readable answer ideas, naturally typeset:
"它们都在数：约束之后，还能独立选择多少。"
"Ax = 0 中，剩下 n − rank(A) 个自由变量。"
"而 y″ + y = 0 的解是 y = a cos x + b sin x。"
"两个初值决定 a 和 b，所以这里留下两个自由度。"
"我们先保留这个共同点，再回到两页各自的条件。"
Show restrained inline source links "线代 · 第8页" and "微分 · 第12页". One selected sentence "约束之后，还能独立选择多少" has a subtle warm-gold underline/selection and a SMALL nearby contextual action "接着问", plus a return-to-source link; no permanent toolbar rows. The composer contains the current unfinished draft "那这里的‘独立’……". The design should communicate that words, references, current work and unfinished input stay together as the exchange continues.

No green UI. No cool gray rectangles, big white board, left gray wall, giant opaque panel, one-card-per-paragraph, speech bubble staircase, busy dashboard, floating unsupported character, split day/night line, sliding arrows, explanatory badges, engineering metadata, checklist, "方案A/B" label, callout arrows or multi-panel storyboard. This must be one beautiful coherent actual application screen, not a presentation board.

DIRECTION B — A SHARED OPEN SHEET BETWEEN TWO PEOPLE:
Use a clearly different interaction structure while retaining EXACT same navigation/composer anchors and typography scale. The user's question and compact PDF pair remain at x96,y132..260. Let the companion's short opening sentence lead into ONE continuous shared manuscript spread at x96..1016,y354..772. This is a single quiet smoked-tea writing surface receiving the lamp's warm side light, with a fine soft edge; no stack of separate boxes. Its interior has TWO aligned unboxed columns: the left holds the current two source snippets in ample readable type, the right is where the two people connect the ideas. Columns are separated by generous breathing space, never a hard rule.

Left upper snippet: small red PDF book "线代", subtle source link "第8页", then "Ax = 0" and "n − rank(A)" with a few readable explanatory lines. Left lower snippet: the other tiny red PDF book "微分", source "第12页", then "y″ + y = 0" and "y = a cos x + b sin x". These are current source objects living inside the same joint work, not thumbnail cards and not invented full PDF screenshots.

The right column connects the two with the sentence "约束之后，还能独立选择多少" and the short explanation about a and b. An elegant small warm curve beneath it can be manipulated at its actual points, without a toolbar or extra instrument panel. Preserve enough ordinary prose above/below the spread that it still reads as a conversation with a person, not an isolated workspace app. The selected phrase is echoed only once near its real paragraph, where the small contextual "接着问" and return-to-source action appear. The shared sheet can naturally grow from a short reply and fold back to the same conversation; do not depict a separate window, modal title bar or second chat input.

Use rich but quiet chestnut/smoked-tea and warm-ivory values appropriate to the actual night scene, including text contrast. Keep background lake/window lamp and wooden material harmonious; never use a large bright white page or neutral gray wall. Show the response, two sources, a tiny dynamic piece and unfinished draft as one continuous bit of shared attention.
